components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.08s ease, filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.975); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5bc42; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #f5bc42; color: #10121a; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); }

components.css: .ds-party { position: relative; padding: 30px 24px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); } .ds-party h2 { margin: 12px 0 6px; font-size: 22px; } .ds-party p { color: var(--text-dim); } .ds-party-tab { position: absolute; top: -1px; right: 24px; padding: 7px 12px 8px; border-radius: 0 0 9px 9px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-party button { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-soft); color: var(--text); font-weight: 800; } .ds-party button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: ImposterGame brings friends to one table, whether they pass one phone around or join a room. The home hub borrows the clarity of a neighborhood noticeboard: paper-like surfaces, sign-ink text, and mustard tabs that mark the next action. Game screens remain a phone-first card table. Both surfaces use semantic theme tokens and support English, Thai, and German.
keyCharacteristics: Two dials, data-mode and data-theme; every theme declares the same tokens in both modes, contrast-checked by a test.
One accent for actions, plus crew green and imposter red reserved for game sides.
A flat noticeboard hub with persistent navigation, an honest party state, two clear play paths, and a word-pack callout.
Game controls remain 52px pills; hub navigation is 52px and primary actions are 52px.
A system sans stack with Thai faces listed first; weight does the hierarchy.
One 24px icon set, 1.8 stroke, round caps, currentColor, each icon with a single motion behind anim.

rules.name: The Two Dials Rule
rules.body: Mode and theme are set once on the root; a rule below the tokens never asks which is on.

rules.name: The Accent Is An Action Rule
rules.body: --accent fills only things you tap; --accent-text is its readable twin for words. Crew and imposter colours mean sides, never emphasis.

rules.name: The Every Theme Declares Everything Rule
rules.body: A new theme declares every token in both modes; theme.test.js fails on a missing token, a contrast failure, or a chip unlike its theme.

rules.name: The Weight Does The Work Rule
rules.body: 800 names, 700 acts, 400 reads; size changes little between roles on a phone.

rules.name: The Mode Owns The Shadow Rule
rules.body: Washes, hairlines, shadows, and glow are declared per mode and shared by every theme.

dos: Do declare every token for both modes when adding a theme, and run src/ui/theme/theme.test.js.
Do use --accent-text, never --accent, for words and hairlines on a plain surface.
Do keep game controls at 52px, hub navigation at 52px, and the game column at 560px (680px wide).
Do give a new icon one motion that is what that object does, off by default.
donts: Don't use crew green or imposter red for emphasis; they mean sides.
Don't let a rule below tokens.css test for the mode or the theme.
Don't add a second type family or motion that carries meaning.
Don't use the mustard hub accent for player teams; crew green and imposter red remain reserved for game roles.
